title: Metformin and type 2 diabetes
text: Metformin is the first-line pharmacological treatment for type 2 diabetes mellitus. It lowers hepatic glucose production and improves insulin sensitivity.

title: Insulin therapy
text: Basal insulin is added when oral agents fail to reach the HbA1c target in type 2 diabetes.

title: Hypertension guidelines
text: For adults with hypertension, ACE inhibitors or calcium channel blockers are recommended as initial therapy. Blood pressure target below 140/90 mmHg.

title: Statins and cardiovascular risk
text: Statins reduce LDL cholesterol and cardiovascular events in patients at high cardiovascular risk.

title: Vitamin D supplementation
text: Vitamin D supplementation did not reduce fracture risk in community-dwelling older adults without deficiency.

title: Omega-3 fatty acids
text: Fish oil omega-3 supplements showed no significant reduction of major cardiovascular events in primary prevention.

title: Asthma management
text: Inhaled corticosteroids are the cornerstone of persistent asthma control; short-acting beta agonists relieve symptoms.

title: Antibiotic stewardship
text: Amoxicillin is the first-line antibiotic for uncomplicated community-acquired pneumonia in adults.

title: Diet and diabetes prevention
text: Lifestyle intervention with diet and physical activity reduced the incidence of type 2 diabetes in people with prediabetes.

title: Aspirin primary prevention
text: Low-dose aspirin for primary prevention increases major bleeding with little cardiovascular benefit in older adults.
